column2: Hello there, friend. How are you?
Good morning! How's your day going?
It's good to see you again.
I don't know if we've met before.
Thank you for coming all this way.
Welcome to Ironforge, traveler.
Are you new to these parts?
Well met, my friend!
Hello, lass. Do you need a hand?
Good evening, lads and lasses.
I haven't seen you in ages!
I hope the road treated you kindly.
Yes, that's me. What can I do for you?
Don't worry about it, you're welcome here.
Oh, I remember you now!
Thanks for stopping by.
It's been a very long day.
I'm pretty sure we met at the tavern.
What brings you to this mountain?
You're looking well, old friend.
I'd best be on my way.
See you tomorrow, my friend.
Stay safe out there.
Thank you, and good night.
I won't forget what you did.
Until we meet again, friend.
I have to leave before sunrise.
Don't get yourself into trouble.
Good luck on your journey.
I should get some sleep.
Let's talk again when we get back.
Sorry, I have to go now.
I don't know where to find those wolves.
Have you seen the quest giver?
Can you help me find the entrance?
We need to gather ten more supplies.
I think the cave is over that hill.
Don't worry, we'll find another way.
The last camp was full of enemies.
I haven't finished this quest yet.
Do you know how to get across the river?
I'm pretty sure the bridge is north of here.
What are you looking for in these ruins?
You'll find the miners near the old quarry.
I have no idea who gave us this task.
We should talk to the captain first.
Is that the same map you found yesterday?
I know this path very well.
I don't think that tunnel is safe.
The flowers are pretty but the wolves are dangerous.
Let's check the other side of the mountain.
I can't find my way back.
Why don't we ask the guard for directions?
That treasure is supposed to be inside the tower.
We'll need a little more time to finish.
I heard there was gold in the old mine.
The abandoned village looks beautiful in the morning.
We haven't searched the eastern ridge yet.
Watch out! There's another patrol coming!
Get behind me, I'll hold them off!
Don't stand in the fire!
You're going to pull another group!
I can't keep fighting without a healer.
That was a pretty tough fight.
I don't know how we survived that.
We need to move before they respawn.
Are you ready for the next pull?
That giant is very strong.
We've got trouble coming from the west.
Don't worry about me, save the others!
I think the enemy is almost dead.
Get out of the way!
The captain has called for reinforcements.
Do you want me to pull first?
I'm tired, but I can keep going.
My weapon is nearly broken.
I haven't used my last potion yet.
We should retreat to the entrance.
No, don't attack that one!
This is a crazy plan, but it might work.
I can't see anything through the smoke.
You have a little blood on your face.
That's the biggest troll I've ever seen.
How much gold do you want for that sword?
I have no gold left after repairing.
Would you take five silver for it?
That's a very good price.
I don't know what this gem is worth.
Are you looking to buy or sell?
This is a pretty little ring.
I've got a new shield for sale.
I can't afford that right now.
Thanks, I'll take two of them.
I've been saving for a better axe.
What do you think of this armor?
That's my last offer, friend.
I know a merchant in Stormwind.
Do you have any spare food?
I won't sell you a broken weapon.
I'm looking for some good leather.
That's a beautiful gem you've found.
No thanks, I've already got one.
Could you please make me a bag?
Sit down, friend. Let me buy you an ale.
A round of drinks for the whole table!
I don't know about you, but I'm thirsty.
This is the best beer I've had all week.
That's a pretty good story, lad.
No, I haven't seen that man before.
Come here and warm yourself by the fire.
You look very tired, my friend.
I won't drink another drop tonight.
Have you heard the story of the lost hammer?
I'd rather have an ale than a fight.
Don't bother the barkeep, he's busy.
I know a song about an old mountain.
That was a crazy night in Ironforge.
She has a beautiful smile, doesn't she?
You'll find my brother at the next table.
The fire is warm and the company is good.
It's been a little while since my last visit.
I have no doubt you'll like the stew.
Oh, you want to hear another story?
I can't remember where I left my mug.
That old lad owes me a drink.
I'm pretty sure this is the right tavern.
What a beautiful little place you've got here.
We should leave before the snow gets worse.
I can't see the road from here.
Is there another path over the mountain?
I'm pretty sure the pass is closed.
Let's rest beside the river for a moment.
I don't know how far we've come.
You won't find a safer road than this.
I've got no food for the next leg.
We were tired after crossing the marsh.
There's a beautiful view from the summit.
I know a little shortcut through the hills.
Don't worry, I packed an extra blanket.
The valley looks pretty at sunrise.
That bridge looks old and broken.
We haven't reached the crossroads yet.
Do you know where this road leads?
This weather is very cold for autumn.
We need to get out of the rain.
My boots are full of mud.
Let's stop before the horses are exhausted.
Does anyone want to run a dungeon?
I don't know if I can make it tonight.
Can you invite my friend too?
I'll be ready in about five minutes.
Thanks for the help earlier.
Don't worry, I'll bring the food.
Doesn't anyone have a spare key?
You should ask the raid leader first.
That's a pretty good idea.
No problem, I can wait.
I haven't seen the tank online today.
Can we try that boss again?
I'm going to repair before we start.
Let me know if you need another healer.
I might be late to the meeting.
I shouldn't have pulled that group.
The plan sounds crazy, but I trust you.
What do you want me to do?
Let's split the loot fairly.
We'll need more people for that event.
How was your day?
I think it's going to rain later.
That sounds like a good plan.
I really don't know what to say.
You're very kind to offer.
I'm pretty tired after all that walking.
I'm pretty sure you're right.
Have you seen that new armor set?
This place is a little quieter than usual.
I love the view from this hill.
What do you think of my new axe?
Oh no, I've forgotten my supplies.
That's a beautiful sunset.
I have no idea what happened.
Yes, I've heard the same rumor.
I won't be staying for long.
That fellow seems rather strange.
I'm sorry to bother you with this.
Did you know the old bridge collapsed?
There's nothing left in the chest.
She's a pretty clever engineer.
I guess that could work.
You shouldn't have to do it alone.
This is very much what I expected.
The dwarf scratches his beard thoughtfully.
The old man takes a slow drink of ale.
She smiles and points toward the mountains.
He tries to man the cannon before sunset.
The woman looks worried about the road.
She is pretty sure the guard heard her.
The captain raises his hammer and laughs.
The young lad studies the map carefully.
He moves a little closer to the fireplace.
The dwarf seems very tired indeed.
He takes a deep breath before speaking.
The guard eyes your pack suspiciously.
The ranger points to a beautiful flower.
His friend has a pretty strange accent.
She waves to the travelers at the gate.
The smith wipes soot from his brow.
The fighter plants his feet in the snow.
The old dwarf has no fear of heights.
He looks over the valley in silence.
The warrior gestures toward the tavern.
I'm pretty sure that's not right.
It's a pretty little village.
It's a pretty little problem.
That's a pretty small old house.
I have no idea what you're saying.
No, I can't do that.
No one has seen him lately.
We have no time to waste.
A crazy idea might be our only chance.
This is crazy good food.
I'm crazy about my new axe.
Man the cannons, we're under attack!
That man has no business here.
Don't bother to open the gate.
Please don't bother me while I'm working.
I've had trouble sleeping lately.
Don't trouble yourself on my account.
You're very good with that hammer.
That's very much appreciated.
You look beautiful today.
It was a beautiful solution to the problem.
What a beautiful little mountain village!
That's a smart ass move.
He gave my ass a swift kick.
The stubborn ass won't move an inch.
That isn't the same thing as this.
That’s a rather odd thing to say.
Those ideas are nothing alike.
I worry about the future sometimes.
You'll have to go without me.
I don't want to bother you.
Doesn't that sound a little strange?
Are you sure that's enough?
She's pretty, but that means nothing.
The place is pretty in the evening.
I'm very, very tired of waiting.
Don't worry, I've got your back.
Wouldn't you agree with me?
You can't be serious about this.
My friend from Westfall is coming.
Don't tell me that's your new weapon.
He hasn't got a clue.
This is going to be trouble.
